description:
This acquisition is restricted to Small Business concerns for NAICS code 238220 (Maint/Repair/Rebuild of Equipment—Refrigeration, Air Conditioning, and Air Circulating Equipment) and the size standard is $19,000,000.00. This is a requirement for the replacement and installation of a new oil shaft seal compatible with an existing chiller.  Please see attachments for the Sources Sought Notice and draft Statement of Work. The Government is only conducting market research and acquiring information to identify contractors that are able to provide the outlined services. Ensure the Sources Sought document is filled out with all components completed.

All correspondence shall be submitted via email to tristan.torres@us.af.mil and bismark.badu.3@us.af.mil and no later than Wednesday, 29 April 2026, at 10:00 AM CDT or sooner. Please see the attached RFQ and all the attachments for further details.
